xmldoc.short_description: Compile a Modelica model to an FMU with OpenModelica.

param_input_item.param_description: a string scalar or character row vector: the path to a .mo file, or inline Modelica source text.
a string: the Modelica class to build. Optional; when omitted it is the .mo base name (file input) or is parsed from the first model / block / class / package declaration (inline source).

option pairs: 'FmiVersion' ('2.0' default, or '3.0'), 'FmuType' ('cs' default Co-Simulation, 'me', or 'me_cs'), 'Libraries' (a string or cell of extra .mo files to load before building), 'Rebuild' (false default; true ignores the cache).

param_output_item.param_description: the path to the produced .fmu file.

description.p: modelicaToFmu compiles a Modelica model to a Functional Mock-up Unit (FMU) using an installed OpenModelica compiler and returns the path to the produced .fmu. It is the compilation half of the nflow Modelica bridge: a modelica block calls it so that the resulting FMU can be simulated through nflow's FMI path.
The result is cached under the temporary directory, keyed by a hash of the source, the model name, the OpenModelica version and the FMU options, so an unchanged model is compiled only once.
For a Modelica variable to become a usable output port after import, declare it output (for example output Real vC;); an ordinary variable is exported with causality local.

Two typed errors can be raised. Nelson:nflow_fmi:modelicaUnavailable when OpenModelica is missing or cannot export an FMU (the build is blocked) -- a present omc is still unable to export when the FMI runtime share/omc/runtime/c/fmi is absent from the install; check the installation with modelicaInfo and set it with modelicaConfigure. Nelson:nflow_fmi:modelicaCompileFailed when omc ran but did not produce the FMU; the message carries the OpenModelica diagnostics.
